authority: spec-kitty-cli release authority for shared package compatibility

packages.contract_surface: volatile mission/WP families + zeitgeist attrs codecs; status-diary reducer with causal (from-lane-continuity) rejection precedence, generalized to every current setter (10.4.1, #5967; built on 10.4.0, #4990) and exempting a migration/backfill reconstruction-seed current setter so it cannot bury a WP's real recorded lifecycle (10.4.2, spec-kitty-events#78); typed WorkObservation contract (10.1.0)
packages.resolution_note: The CLI consumes the public PyPI release train with a bounded range; 10.4.2 is the release-authority lock target. 10.4.1 generalized from-lane continuity to every setter (closing the cancel/rework split-brain the 10.4.0 rollback-setter-only form missed) but over-rejected migrated missions: a genesis-time migration:backfill reconstruction seed became the current setter and dropped the WP's real lifecycle. 10.4.2 (spec-kitty-events#78) exempts a reconstruction-seed current setter so the real lifecycle wins, with the #5967 cancel/rework fix and the rollback/force exemptions unchanged (spec-kitty-events#77/#78 / spec-kitty#5967).
The CLI consumes the public PyPI release train with a bounded range; 0.5.2 is the release-authority lock target.
